display.purpose: One per page: the hero headline and the closing line. Condensed Archivo 800.

headline.purpose: Section headings; 3rem below 640px, 3.75rem above. Also the auth panel title (at 0.92 line-height).

numeral.purpose: Kyu/dan numbers set monumentally with a small muted unit; scales to 5.5rem in the record figure.

title.purpose: Belt names in the syllabus. Condensed 700.

title-plain.purpose: Step headings and card titles at normal width.

lede.purpose: Section intros and the hero subline, about 65ch max.

body-small.purpose: Step descriptions, list meta, form fields from 768px.

label.purpose: Condensed tabular meta in sentence case: ladder ranges, drill header, counts.

mono.purpose: Code, drill editor, test cases and REPL on a 24px line grid; ligatures off.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Text inputs on focus-visible, with a Jade Ring border. The only shadow in the system.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Focus on every other interactive element (not a shadow; recorded here as the focus treatment).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The curve for both signature motions.

motion.name: tape-on
motion.value: 420ms ease-out-expo; clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0), translateY(-6px) to 0
motion.purpose: A freshly earned stripe pressed onto the rank bar, in straw.

motion.name: seal-stamp
motion.value: 520ms ease-out-expo; scale 1.35 + blur 2px + opacity 0, to 0.96 at 60%, to 1; rotation held at -7deg
motion.purpose: The examiner's seal landing on passed work.

motion.name: state
motion.value: 150ms on background-color, border-color, color, opacity, transform
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and re-grading dims (55% opacity). No layout-affecting transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms; smooth scroll off
motion.purpose: Global prefers-reduced-motion collapse. Celebrations must honour it.

components.description: The single jade action. Every primary CTA, form submit and 'Submit drill'.

components.name: Belt Band
components.description: Signature rank object: dyed cloth with stitch rows, a keyline edge and a tail rank bar of tape stripes; the fresh stripe tapes on in straw.
components.css: .ds-belt { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: stretch; width: 14rem; height: 24px; background-color: var(--belt-green, oklch(0.72 0.1 145)); color: var(--keyline, oklch(0.4 0.035 162)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--keyline, oklch(0.4 0.035 162)) 60%, transparent); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, transparent calc(25% - 0.5px), color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 14%, transparent) calc(25% - 0.5px), color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 14%, transparent) 25%); } .ds-belt-bar { display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px 5px; background: var(--belt-black, oklch(0.3 0.03 162)); } .ds-stripe { width: 5px; background: transparent; } .ds-stripe-on { background: var(--tape, oklch(0.985 0.008 100)); } .ds-stripe-fresh { background: var(--highlight, oklch(0.88 0.12 95)); animation: ds-tape-on 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-tape-on { from { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transform: translateY(-6px); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stripe-fresh { animation: none; } }

components.name: Examiner's Seal
components.description: Square jade stamp, rotated -7deg, pressed onto passed work with the seal-stamp motion. The only uppercase lettering in the system.
components.html: PassedDrill 1
components.css: .ds-seal { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 3px; border: 3px solid var(--seal, oklch(0.52 0.11 162)); color: var(--seal, oklch(0.52 0.11 162)); transform: rotate(-7deg); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: "wdth" 72; animation: ds-seal-stamp 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-seal-inner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--seal, oklch(0.52 0.11 162)); } .ds-seal-label { font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-seal-detail { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.625rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } @keyframes ds-seal-stamp { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(1.35); filter: blur(2px); } 60% { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(0.96); filter: blur(0); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-seal { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
pylearn is set like the printed syllabus of a martial-arts school, rendered in jade and straw. Python is a discipline you are graded in: the Python track counts kyu down from white belt to black belt, and AI automation continues in dan ranks. Every visual device serves that idea. Belts are woven cloth (stitch rows, a keyline edge, a rank bar at the tail). Passed work gets a tilted, square examiner's seal. Progress is tape stripes pressed onto a belt. Content is ruled into syllabus rows, not boxed into cards.

The palette is balanced: soft enough to live with for a 90-minute evening session, with enough colour to feel alive. The ground is green-tinted cotton and the ink is deep forest green. One jade accent carries every action and the seal. A straw-yellow highlight appears only where the learner stands or has just earned something. Belt dyes are rank data and nothing else. In dark mode the ground becomes forest-green cloth in an evening training hall. The jade lightens to stay legible and the dyes stay soft. Loud, saturated accents (red in particular) and flat grey or slate were both tried and rejected by the owner. That rejection is part of the system.

Density is that of a well-set reference document. There are large condensed headings and generous section bands (80 to 112px), and inside them compact ruled rows with tabular meta. The surface is flat. Depth comes from two tones of cloth (ground and sheet) and hairlines, never from shadow.
keyCharacteristics: One family, Archivo, used across its width axis: condensed for ranks and headings, normal for reading. JetBrains Mono is for code only.
A jade accent is the single action colour. Straw marks position and the moment of earning.
Belt dyes (white, yellow, green, blue, brown, black) appear only as rank data.
Square-cut geometry with 0 to 3px corners, keylined belt bands, and a square seal.
Flat cloth: tonal layering and hairline rules, with no drop shadows.
Motion is reserved for earning: the tape-on stripe and the seal stamp.

rules.name: The Jade Voice Rule
rules.body: Jade is the only colour that means "act". Primary buttons, links, the seal, focus and selection use it. No second action colour exists.

rules.name: The Straw Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Straw marks where the learner stands and what they just earned: the here-tag, the fresh stripe, and the dan bars still to come. It is never a button, a heading colour, a section band or decoration.

rules.name: The Dye Is Data Rule
rules.body: Belt dyes appear only where they encode rank. They are never category colours, chart series, difficulty labels or decorative fills.

rules.name: The Balanced Chroma Rule
rules.body: Accents sit near chroma 0.11 to 0.12, and no colour in the system exceeds 0.13. Every neutral keeps a green tint (chroma 0.006 or more). A new colour that is louder than jade, or greyer than the hairline, is off-system.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries everything except code. Width communicates role: condensed (`wdth` 72) for ranks, headings, belt names and meta; semicondensed (86) only for the wordmark; normal for reading. Don't add a second display face.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, meta, nav, form labels, menu items and dialog titles are sentence case at normal tracking. Letter-spaced uppercase belongs only to the stamped lettering inside the Seal (0.06em and 0.08em), because a stamp is the one object in this world that is lettered that way.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that counts (kyu, module index, lesson count, hours, line numbers, streak length) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Syllabus Row Rule
rules.body: Collections of modules, lessons, exercises or achievements are ruled rows with index, title and meta. They are not grids of boxed cards. A panel (sheet with a hairline border) is for one interactive or framed object, such as a drill, a record or a code comparison.

rules.name: The Flat Cloth Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. To lift something, change its tone (ground to sheet, or sheet to Jade Wash) and give it a hairline. Hard offset shadows and ambient glows are off-system.

rules.name: The Square Cut Rule
rules.body: Corners stay between 0 and 3px. Nothing in the system is a pill or a circle, whether a badge, avatar frame, progress ring or level token. Progress is linear or striped.

dos: Do use Jade (oklch(0.52 0.11 162)) for every primary action and link, and keep it the only action colour on any screen.
Do reserve Straw (oklch(0.88 0.12 95)) for the learner's current position and the moment of earning: the here-tag, the fresh stripe and pending dan bars.
Do show rank and progress as stripes on a Belt Band. Show counts as a condensed tabular Numeral with a small muted unit ("9 kyu").
Do set lists of modules, lessons, exercises and achievements as ruled syllabus rows with index, title and right-aligned tabular meta.
Do separate regions with hairlines and the ground/sheet tone shift. Give a framed object 3px corners and a 1px hairline.
Do keep labels, headings and menu items in sentence case at normal tracking, in condensed Archivo for meta.
Do play tape-on (420ms) or seal-stamp (520ms) only when the learner earns something, and keep every other state change at 150ms on colour, opacity or a 1px press.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: animations and transitions collapse to 0.01ms and smooth scroll turns off. Celebrations and confetti must respect it too.
Do design dark mode as forest-green cloth with Night Jade, not as an inverted light theme, and check both themes for every new surface.
Do use Lucide line icons at 16px, muted by default and ink on hover, with `aria-hidden` when they are decorative.
donts: Don't introduce saturated or dominant accents. Saturated red was explicitly rejected. Clay (oklch(0.54 0.13 30)) is for errors only, as text or a thin border, never a fill.
Don't use flat grey or slate neutrals. Every neutral carries the green tint.
Don't use belt dyes for categories, difficulty, charts or decoration. Dye means rank.
Don't use drop shadows, glows or hard offset shadows. The input focus halo is the only shadow.
Don't use pills, circles or radii above 3px, including circular progress rings, rounded-full level badges and pill tabs.
Don't use letter-spaced uppercase labels, eyebrows or kickers. The Seal's stamped lettering is the only uppercase in the system.
Don't use emoji as icons or status (no 🔥 streaks, no trophy glyphs).
Don't build dashboards as grids of stat cards. Put numbers in a record figure or a ruled row.
Don't hardcode Tailwind palette colours (amber, emerald, red, blue and so on) or hex values in components. Use the tokens.
Don't fabricate social proof. Example data must be labelled as an example, as the training-record figure is.
